# Modal

`Modal` is an utility component for creating dialogs, popovers, etc.<br />
It renders its `children` in front of a backdrop component.

If you are creating a modal dialog, you probably want to use the <LinkTo kind="Components/Dialog">Dialog</LinkTo> component.

<Source code="import { Modal } from &#x22;@airbus/components-react&#x22;" />

<Primary />

<Controls />

### Focus

For the benefit of assistive technologies and keyboard navigation,
focus will be set automatically on the first tabbable child (button, link, input, etc.)

The `Modal` component also handles the logic to trap focus.

To control what element gets focus first and the tabbing order, use [tabIndex](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Global_attributes/tabindex) values.
You can also avoid scrolling by wrapping content in a `<div tabIndex="-1"></div>` element.

See https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/dialog-modal/#keyboardinteraction
